paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: Shapley values by relative position to the probed target word. The values are averaged over the tasks.
model_annotation: This grouped bar chart illustrates Shapley values by relative position to a probed target word, averaged over multiple tasks. The horizontal axis categorizes these discrete relative positions, ordered sequentially from left to right as L_4+, L_3, L_2, L_1, T, R_1, R_2, R_3, and R_4+. The vertical axis represents the "Shapley value" on a linear scale ranging from slightly below 0 to 80, with numeric tick labels provided at intervals of 20 and marked by corresponding horizontal grid lines. Within each positional category, up to three side-by-side bars represent different models, as identified in the top-right legend: mBERT in light blue, XLM-R in dark blue, and chLSTM in light green. All bars feature a thin black outline and are not additionally emphasized. The categories on the horizontal axis are sorted by their relative structural position rather than by ascending or descending numerical value. The highest values strictly occur at the central position "T", where the tallest bar overall belongs to chLSTM at approximately 79, while mBERT and XLM-R reach roughly 59 and 54, respectively. The bars are notably shorter at adjacent positions, such as L_1 (where all three models measure near 14) and R_1 (ranging from approximately 8.5 to 10.5). The shortest positive bars occur for mBERT and XLM-R at positions like L_3 and R_3, measuring near or below 2. Furthermore, the chLSTM model exhibits small negative values extending just below the zero baseline at positions L_4+, R_2, R_3, and R_4+, reaching a minimum of approximately -1.5 at R_2 and R_3.
